newsitem.title: EU: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 23-Sunday, June 30.
newsitem.headline: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 23-Sunday, June 30.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
LUXEMBOURG - EU agriculture ministers meet (Mon-Wed); discussions focus on 1997-98 farm price package.
NEW YORK - 70 world leaders including European Union representatives attend U.N. General Assembly session on the environment (Mon-Fri).

BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (Wed-Thurs); agenda items include rules on takeover bids (Weds); statements by the Council of Ministers and European Commission on the outcome of the Amsterdam EU summit (Thurs).

BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (Weds); discussions focus on Italy's economic convergence programme to qualify for participation in the single currency, legislation for the European Central Bank.
THE HAGUE - EU-Japan summit (Weds).
LUXEMBOURG - EU foreign ministers meet (Thurs).
LUXEMBOURG - EU education ministers meet (Thurs); public hearing on "Education, training, research: barriers to trans-national mobility".
BRUSSELS - European Commission regular weekly meeting (Thurs).
AMSTERDAM - EU briefs central and eastern European countries on the outcome of the EU Amsterdam summit (Fri).
LUXEMBOURG - EU telecoms ministers meet (Fri).
LUXEMBOURG - EU social affairs ministers meet (Fri).
MONDAY, JUNE 23

LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU agriculture ministers meet (1500/1300 GMT) (to Wed). Agenda includes: 1997/1998 farm price package; support for certain arable crop producers; state of negotiations in veterinary and plant health sector; pesticide residues.
LUXEMBOURG (MODIFIED ITEM) - EU finance ministers meeting has BEEN CANCELLED.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Inquiry Committee into BSE meets - Scientific Steering Committee Chairman Fritz Kemper gives address on the transparency of the policy to combat mad cow disease and on the scientific advisory committees (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee meets - European Commissioner Marin attends (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS - European Centre for Policy Studies (CEPS) holds conference on "The Maghreb: an economic and political assessment" (0945/0745 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

NEW YORK (NEW ITEM) - 70 world leaders including European Union representatives attend U.N. General Assembly session on the environment (to Fri). Discussions focus on progress made since the Earth Summit five years ago. European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Bjerregaard participate.
TUESDAY, JUNE 24
LISBON (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Monti attends Schengen Executive Committee meeting.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Regional Policy Committee meets - European Investment Bank Vice-President Luis Marti Espluga gives address on the EIB's role in assisting eonomic and social cohesion in the Union and its work in the countries applying for membership (0930/0730 GMT); European Commissioner Wulf-Mathies gives address on the conclusions of the cohesion forum of April 28-30 and regional planning ministers' meeting (1130/0930 GMT).
BRUSSELS (MODIFIED ITEM) - International Donors conference for Bosnia has BEEN POSTPONED.
BRUSSELS - Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (1100/0900 GMT).
BRUSSELS - Credit Lyonnais holds conference on "EMU and its repercussions on the global financial market" (1445/1245 GMT). Venue: Espace Moselle, 40 rue de Drapiers.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "The Luxembourg presidency of the Council of Ministers" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is: Permanent Representative of Luxembourg to the EU Jean-Jacques Kasel. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

BRUSSELS - Forum Europe holds conference on "Making Europe's defence industry work" (0930/0730 GMT). Agenda includes: towards an EU single defence market; structures for future rationalisation; Europe and the U.S. - Doing business between allies; building a transatlantic partnership. Venue: Concert Noble. Contact: Forum Europe (322) 736 1430.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU Monetary Committee meets (1000/0800 GMT). Discussions focus on Italy's economic convergence programme to qualify for participation in the single currency; legislation for the European Central Bank.

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Parliament holds mini session (1500/1300 GMT) (first of two days). Agenda includes directive on company law concerning takeover bids; rules on classification, packaging and labelling of dangerous preparations; policies for promoting the information society; EU imports of hormone-treated meat; reports on 1995 programmes for aiding the EU's poorer regions; PHARE programme of aid to Eastern Europe; EU-Kyrgyzstan interim trade agreement.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee meets - UN High Representative Carlos Westendorp speaks about the situation in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
THE HAGUE (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU-Japan summit. Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda, European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Brittan attend.

PALERMO, Italy - Euro-Mediterranean Finance Institute holds conference on "Investment and trade in the Mediterranean region: challenges and opportunities" (to Fri). Venue: Castello Utveggio. Contact: Tanguy de Craecker (322) 733 5940.

AMSTERDAM - The Netherlands Industrial and Agricultural Biotechnology (NIAB) Foundation holds "EuropaBio '97" (to Fri). Speakers include: European Commissioner Brittan, Dutch Economic Affairs Minister Hans Wijers. Venue: RAI Congress Centre. Contact: Lidy Groot Congress Events (31) 20 679 3218. Commission clears GE/BankAmerica/Spanish cable deal
EUROPEAN COMMISSION PRESS RELEASE: IP/97/547
DOCUMENT DATE: JUNE 20, 1997
THE COMMISSION AUTHORISES THE ACQUISITION OF JOINT CONTROL
BY BANK OF AMERICA AND GENERAL ELECTRIC ON THE SPANISH
COMPANY CABLEUROPA

The European Commission has authorised under the Community Merger control Regulation an operation by which the undertakings BankAmerica International Investment Corporation and General Electric Capital Services Structured Finance Group, Inc. acquire joint control of Cableuropa S.A. ("Cableuropa"). Cableuropa is a Spanish company active in the provision of services using or related to cable television networks ("CATV"). It will face active competition from other companies with a very strong presence in the markets affected and in particular Telefonica.

Cableuropa will bid for the necessary authorisations for the deployment and operation of CATV networks and telecommunications services in Spain. With Cableuropa a competitor will be introduced in the Spanish market place with both the technical ability to provide a full range of telecommunication and media services and the financial strength to sustain its competitiveness beyond the short term. in the telecommunications field and Sogecable in the pay tv market.

Therefore, the Commission has concluded that the notified operation falls within the scope of Council Regulation N# 4064/89 and does not raise serious doubts as to its compatibility with the common market and with the functioning of the EEA agreement.
